about: Held-out decomposition questions for M2.2, written after the validators (facts, repair, part limit) were added and never used to change them. Same format as decomposition_cases.json. The reported held-out coverage comes from one run.

cases.question: My husband and two kids will join me. How much money do we need, and do the kids need biometrics?
How long will my PGWP be after an 18-month diploma, and can I work full-time while waiting for it?
Is a PAL needed for a master's in British Columbia and is a GIC mandatory?
What IELTS score gives CLB 9, and how many CRS points is that worth?
For my parents' visit, do they need a visitor visa, do they need biometrics, and how long can they stay?
My permit expired last week. Can I restore my status, and how much does it cost?
Can I work on campus from my first day, and do I need a SIN for that?
How long does processing take for a study permit from Nigeria, and where do I give biometrics?
Do I qualify for the Canadian Experience Class with 1 year of work, and which language tests are accepted?
Do children under 14 need to give biometrics for a visitor visa?
